description: This file contains utility functions related to chat session filtering and labeling within an Android application. Specifically, it provides functions for generating human-readable session names and resolving session choices based on recency and current session context.

methods.name: friendlySessionName
methods.description: Generates a clean, human-friendly name from a raw session key by removing prefixes, normalizing words, and formatting them into a readable label.

methods.name: resolveSessionChoices
methods.description: Determines a list of relevant chat sessions based on current session, recency, and main session key, prioritizing recent and main sessions for user interface display.
